Definition: copper, hence, something made of that metal, i.e. coin, a fetter; figuratively, base (as compared with gold or silver)
BiblicalUsage: 1) copper, bronze; 1a) copper (ore), bronze (as copper alloy); 1b) fetters (of copper or bronze); 1c) copper (as value); 2) lust, harlotry; 2a) meaning dubious
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
